summary.title: PLD Space manages its relationship with shareholders through Sttok's investor portal

quote.text: We use Sttok to manage our relationship with our shareholders and investors, along with its main features such as the shareholder register, general meetings, incentive plans and the board of directors.
quote.author: PLD Space

features.value: Investor portal, shareholder register, incentive plans, general meeting and e-signature

sections.title: About PLD Space
texts: PLD Space is the Spanish company developing Miura 5, a reusable rocket to put small satellites into orbit. It is based in Elche (Alicante) and builds its launchers in its own facilities.
Behind each round there are investors grouped in several vehicles, and each one needs to be up to date with their shares, their meetings and their documents.
